preferred_strong_strategy.reason: Only one healthy bearing is local; a bearing holdout cannot preserve both classes in train and test.

provisional_step04_strategy.rule: All windows from one measurement must remain in exactly one split.
provisional_step04_strategy.limitation: Bearing identity is shared across splits; results do not estimate unseen-bearing generalization.

leakage_validation: assert_no_group_leakage(train measurement IDs, test measurement IDs)
operating_condition_holdout: optional secondary experiment, not the P0 split
